rekindle.description: Local session continuity engine for Claude Code. Provides boot reports with orientation scoring, structured end-session capture, and memory search. Requires Node.js 22 or newer. Run `npx rekindle@0.5.1 init` in your project first to create the local database. Plain init installs no hooks; use `npx rekindle@0.5.1 init --with-delivery` to also install the session-start delivery hook.
